user.title: Plenitude
user.description: Choose where to read your bills from.

account.title: Plenitude account
account.description: Sign in with the email and password of the Plenitude app. A verification code will be sent to your email. The password is not stored.

data_description.codice: The 6-digit code in the email from Plenitude.
data_description.reinvia: Tick to receive a new code instead of entering one.

data_description.intervallo_ore: How often, in hours, to read bills, consumption and readings from the account.
data_description.config_entry_myitalgas: If you choose a MyItalgas supply, the gas prices read from the bills are used to create the tariff periods there.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Plenitude session has expired. Sign in again: a new verification code will be sent to your email.

cartella.title: Folder of PDF bills
cartella.description: Bills are read from a folder.

data_description.cartella_bollette: Folder (under the Home Assistant configuration) where to put the Plenitude PDF bills. Copy them by hand or have an automation drop them there (for example the IMAP integration when the e-mail arrives).
data_description.intervallo_ore: How often, in hours, to re-check the folder.
data_description.config_entry_myitalgas: If you choose a MyItalgas supply, the gas prices read from the bills are used to create the tariff periods there.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Plenitude. Try again later.
error.account_bloccato: Too many attempts: the account is temporarily locked. Try again later.
error.verifica_scaduta: The verification has expired. Close this window and start again.

abort.account_diverso: This is a different Plenitude account from the configured one.

data.conto_gas: Plenitude gas account linked to MyItalgas

data_description.cartella_bollette: Folder (under the Home Assistant configuration) where to put the Plenitude PDF bills. Copy them by hand or have an automation drop them there (for example the IMAP integration when the e-mail arrives).
data_description.intervallo_ore: How often, in hours, to update the data.
data_description.config_entry_myitalgas: If you choose a MyItalgas supply, the gas prices read from the bills are used to create the tariff periods there.
